Title: Public preview: New Azure Maps Creator feature - custom styling

Body.Content:
Azure Maps Creator has added the ability to customize the styling of indoor maps. With custom styling, you can fully customize how your indoor maps are rendered. Everything is configurable from the color of a feature, the icon that renders, or the zoom level when a feature should appear or disappear. Once you have a style configured, those settings can be used in your other indoor maps.

To get started with Azure Maps Creator custom styling, see how-to create custom styles for indoor maps.

To get started with Azure Maps and Azure Maps Creator, see the Azure Maps documentation or create a free Azure Maps account.
